operations.description: single-contact detail; the docs show it returns a superset of fields (title, company, address, country, city, state, zip, birthday, phones[], sites[], social[], custom_fields[]) versus the list endpoint's documented email/first_name/last_name/image_url subset only - modeling it as its own stream would require an id already discovered from the contacts stream and would emit a fundamentally different (richer) record shape for the same logical resource, which one schema-per-stream projection cannot express as a variant of the already-covered contacts stream without misrepresenting what the list variant actually returns
operations.approval: not implemented: the direct-read executor has no non-redacting output policy for this provider operation
